title: ARCLET — An adjustable ear clip and cuff with a detachable chain, 6 deliverables

# ARCLET — client facts

## Project and components

- Audience: adult wearers without ear piercings; product team; jewellery workshop.
- Component count: one lobe clip C, one helix cuff H, one detachable chain K.
- Wearing side: left ear for all three components.
- Decorative parts: the same C and H bodies across E1 and E2.
- Adaptation: adjustable setting positions for the two profiles.

## Fixed wearer fixtures

| Profile | Ear side | Lobe type | Overall ear height | Maximum ear width | Lobe height | Lobe thickness |
| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |
| E1 | LEFT | Attached | 60 mm | 30 mm | 16 mm | 5 mm |
| E2 | LEFT | Free | 70 mm | 35 mm | 20 mm | 7 mm |

- ear-fit.png: two adult left-ear schematic profiles, E1 and E2; original image without labels or dimensions.
- Dimension source: the numeric fixture records in this fact sheet.
- Contour role: schematic fitting geometry; cuff and clip forms remain open design variables.
- H contact region: 12 mm along the upper outer rim; helix cuff H contact area.
- L contact region: 10 mm at the lower lobe edge; lobe clip C contact area.
- Ear canal: open clearance.
- Retention mechanism: adjustable mechanical closure acting through visibly padded opposed contact surfaces.
- Contact geometry: silicone-padded surfaces with an opening and release mechanism.

## Chain and decorative-body limits

| Item | Fixed record |
| --- | --- |
| C decorative-body envelope | 20 × 20 × 8 mm |
| H decorative-body envelope | 25 × 15 × 8 mm |
| Envelope scope | Decorative bodies; flexible pads and chain excluded |
| K adjustable length | Designer-selected range within 65–95 mm |
| K end connections | Two tool-free detachable closures |
| Independent use | C and H individually wearable with K detached |
| Worn K geometry | Slack drape between the two fixings |
| Maximum downward offset | 30 mm from lobe bottom to the lowest point of K |
| Removal order | Chain detachment, followed by opening the ear contacts |

- Final body dimensions: design selections within the recorded envelopes.
- Chain construction and closures: part of the jewellery design.
- Wearing settings: selected lengths within the declared adjustable range.
- Scale criteria: ear dimensions, decorative-body envelopes and chain drape.

## Materials

| Part | Material | Finish or design variable |
| --- | --- | --- |
| C and H structural metal | Uncoated titanium | Brushed or polished; actual thickness selected in the design |
| K and its closures | Uncoated titanium | Brushed or polished; construction and section dimensions selected in the design |
| Contact pads | Silicone | Pad form and actual dimensions selected in the design |
| Optional accents | Translucent acrylic | Accent colour selected in the design |

- Prototype priorities: fit, skin contact, edge finish and retention.

## Wearing representation

- Wearing-board labels: E1 or E2; LEFT; selected chain length; lobe-bottom offset.
- Main view: full ear contour and visible jewellery contacts.
- Secondary view: one small rear/contact inset per wearing board.
- Profile distinction: attached lobe for E1; free lobe for E2.
- Relative scale: stipulated ear dimensions and the same jewellery bodies across both profiles.
- Representation options: portrait crops, diagrammatic ears or rendered ears.
- Presentation variables: skin tone, hairstyle and camera position.
- Wearer identity: open; ear-fit.png supplies schematic geometry.

## Fixed identity and atmosphere

- Printed name: ARCLET.
- Printed wearing-side label: LEFT.
- Existing emblem: two nested charcoal arcs, both opening to the right, with rounded terminals and equal stroke weight.
- arclet-emblem.png: fixed emblem identity.
- titanium-textiles.png: brushed and polished titanium, silicone, translucent acrylic and neutral clothing textures.
- Reference role: material and wardrobe atmosphere.

# ARCLET — delivery catalog

This table lists every commissioned deliverable with its tier, file format and stage. What each deliverable must contain is stated in the commission letter.

| # | id | Deliverable | Tiers | Format and stage |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| 1 | assembled-system | Assembled system and dimensions | 6 | Format: PNG, 2400 by 1600 proportion, long side at least 1024 pixels. Stage: final. |
| 2 | connection-details | Fixing and chain connection details | 6 | Format: PNG, 2400 by 1600 proportion, long side at least 1024 pixels. Stage: final. |
| 3 | final-materials | Final materials and contact details | 6 | Format: PNG, 2400 by 1600 proportion, long side at least 1024 pixels. Stage: final. |
| 4 | standalone-components | Independent clip and cuff product views | 6 | Format: PNG, 2400 by 1600 proportion, long side at least 1024 pixels. Stage: final. |
| 5 | e1-wearing | E1 attached-lobe wearing board | 6 | Format: PNG, 1600 by 2400 proportion, long side at least 1024 pixels. Stage: final. |
| 6 | e2-wearing | E2 free-lobe wearing board | 6 | Format: PNG, 1600 by 2400 proportion, long side at least 1024 pixels. Stage: final. |

steps.userMessage:
ARCLET | An adjustable ear clip and cuff with a detachable chain

We are developing an ear jewellery system for adults who express their style through non-pierced accessories. Design exactly one left-ear lobe clip C, one left-ear helix cuff H and one detachable chain K. Our two fitting profiles are E1, an attached lobe with ear height 60 mm, maximum width 30 mm, lobe height 16 mm and lobe thickness 5 mm; and E2, a free lobe with corresponding dimensions of 70 mm, 35 mm, 20 mm and 7 mm. C contacts only the 10 mm region L at the lower lobe edge; H contacts only the 12 mm region H along the upper outer rim. Both fixings use adjustable mechanical closures with visibly padded opposed contacts, leaving the ear canal open. The same decorative parts serve both profiles through adjustment.

Use uncoated titanium for the structural metal and chain, silicone contact pads, and optional translucent acrylic accents. C’s decorative body fits within 20 × 20 × 8 mm; H’s fits within 25 × 15 × 8 mm, with pads and chain outside those envelopes. Develop the chain construction and closures, with tool-free detachment at both ends and independent use of C and H. Choose an adjustable chain-length range within 65–95 mm. In use, K hangs with visible slack and its lowest point sits at most 30 mm below the lobe bottom. Use our existing twin-arc emblem and print "ARCLET" on all six boards; print "LEFT" on both wearing boards.

Audience: the product team and jewellery workshop, for selecting the finished design and planning its first prototypes for adult wearers without ear piercings.

Inputs (attached): 01-client-facts.en.md contains the fitting dimensions, component limits and material records. 02-delivery-catalog.en.md lists the six deliverables with their proportions, formats and stages. ear-fit.png is the constraint image showing the E1 and E2 left-ear contours; the fact sheet supplies their dimensions and contact-region lengths. arclet-emblem.png is the fixed identity image containing our twin-arc emblem. titanium-textiles.png is an atmosphere reference for metal finish, translucent accents and neutral clothing textures.

Deliverables:
1. One assembled system board with front, rear and side views of C, H and K, final decorative-body dimensions and the selected chain-length range
2. One connection detail board with sections through both padded fixings, adjustment and opening positions, both chain closures and a numbered removal sequence
3. One final materials board identifying titanium finishes and thicknesses, silicone pad forms and dimensions, any acrylic accent colour, and prototype priorities for fit, skin contact, edge finish and retention
4. One standalone product board with front and rear views of C and H in their independently wearable states and K laid out separately with both end closures open
5. One E1 wearing board showing the complete linked system on the attached-lobe left ear, the full ear contour, a rear/contact inset, selected chain length and vertical lobe-bottom offset
6. One E2 wearing board showing the same linked system on the free-lobe left ear, the full ear contour, a rear/contact inset, selected chain length and vertical lobe-bottom offset

Acceptance:
- The assembled system and standalone product boards contain exactly C, H and K; the assembled system board dimensions C within 20 × 20 × 8 mm and H within 25 × 15 × 8 mm, excluding pads and chain.
- The connection detail board shows mechanical adjustment, opposed silicone pads and release for C and H, tool-free operation at both ends of K, and removal steps that detach K before opening either ear contact; the standalone product board carries the same closures.
- The E1 and E2 wearing boards preserve their respective 60 × 30 mm and 70 × 35 mm ear proportions, 16 mm and 20 mm lobe heights, and 5 mm and 7 mm lobe thicknesses in the contact insets. They use the same decorative bodies, place C within L and H within H, and leave the ear canal open.
- The assembled system board declares an adjustable range within 65–95 mm; both wearing boards label a selected length inside that range and a vertical offset of at most 30 mm below the lobe bottom, with visible slack between the fixings.
- The final materials board identifies uncoated titanium, silicone, chosen metal thicknesses, pad dimensions and any acrylic colour; those materials and finishes recur across the other five boards. Its prototype priorities cover fit, skin contact, edge finish and retention.
- All six boards carry ARCLET and the supplied twin-arc emblem. The E1 and E2 wearing boards carry their respective profile label and LEFT, with the rear/contact inset corresponding to the main left-ear view.

Please clearly mark which version you consider the final deliverable. If nothing is marked, the last exported version counts.
